title: Rupee posts strongest week since March on RBI support
description: The Indian rupee finished Friday on a strong note, marking its most significant weekly increase since March, thanks to continuous support from the central bank amidst a weakening dollar. Heightened tensions in the Middle East have driven oil prices upward, influencing the rupee's monthly trends. Likewise, India's IT sector demonstrated impressive growth this month, outshining the overall market.

title: Global Market: Nikkei ends sharply higher as global AI momentum boosts markets

Advantest jumped 16% and SoftBank soared 14%, while Panasonic surged 19.5% on a higher profit outlook. Automakers lagged as a stronger yen weighed on export earnings following central bank intervention.

title: Cube Highways Trust InvIT debuts with 2% premium over issue price of Rs 152

title: Global Market: European shares hit record high as tech rally, earnings lift sentiment

title: Sun Pharma Q1 Results: Profit rises 27% YoY to Rs 2,895 crore; revenue climbs 10.5%
description: Sun Pharma Q1 Results: Sun Pharma reported a 27% YoY rise in Q1 net profit to Rs 2,895 crore, while revenue grew 10% to Rs 15,300 crore, driven by strong performance in India and its innovative medicines business despite weak US formulations sales. EBITDA rose 3% to Rs 4,418 crore. The company highlighted semaglutide approvals and said the Organon acquisition remains on track for early 2027.

title: Global Market: Euro zone, US bond yields log biggest monthly rise since March on Middle East inflation concerns

Traders pushed back interest rate cut expectations, with Germany’s 10-year yield rising 28 basis points in July and US 10-year Treasury yields advancing 22.5 basis points despite a Friday dip.
